items.title: indistinct-stance-directions
items.claim: In image #3, both horizontal STANCE hints say 'step', while the neighboring TECHNIQUE hints distinguish 'back' from 'forward'.
items.reason: The stance hints do not explain which direction closes distance and which creates space.
items.suggest: Use 'back step' and 'forward step' for the pictured facing, keeping those labels synchronized with the fighter's facing.

items.title: misplaced-combination-symbol
items.claim: In image #6, the '+' occupies an otherwise unlabeled cell beside RETREATING within the STANCE legend rather than separating the STANCE and TECHNIQUE groups.
items.reason: Its placement makes the instruction to combine the two sticks harder to understand.
items.suggest: Place 'One stance + one technique' in a dedicated full-width instruction between the two groups.

items.title: ambiguous-technique-dimming
items.claim: In image #6, the Spinning Back Kick row is visibly dimmer than the preceding rows, without a visible label explaining its status.
items.reason: A player could mistake a scroll-edge treatment for an unavailable technique; the still cannot establish which causes the dimming.
items.suggest: Keep readable technique rows undimmed and confine any scroll-edge fade to a gutter that does not cover their text or input symbols.

items.title: missing-desktop-key-legends
items.claim: In desktop image #9, the two sticks show direction marks and STANCE/TECHNIQUE labels, but no keyboard bindings are visible.
items.reason: A keyboard player cannot discover the corresponding keys from this screen.
items.suggest: Add compact legends beside each stick using the actual configured keyboard bindings, while retaining the touch controls.

items.title: result-countdown-without-cancel
items.claim: In images #8 and #18, REMATCH appears above 'STARTING IN 8', with no visible control to cancel the indicated start.
items.reason: A player reviewing the result has no visible way to request more time.
items.suggest: Keep REMATCH as the primary action and add a clearly labeled 'Stay on results' control that cancels the countdown.
